title: Strings that YAML 1.1 reads as booleans
refs: YAML 1.1 types (yaml.org/type): bool, int, float, timestamp, merge, value
notes: The Core schema reads these as strings, but YAML 1.1 reads each as a boolean, and many existing readers still do (libyaml and PyYAML, Psych and SnakeYAML among them). As strings they are quoted. This is a writing convention of the family, not the specification: a string is written plain only when every common reader reads it as that same string, so the text is judged under the YAML 1.2 Core schema (loose) and also under YAML 1.1 and the number forms common readers accept (strict).
